description: This file implements the OfflineFirstUserDataRepository class which manages user data by interacting with data sources and tracking user actions via analytics. It provides methods to update user preferences such as followed topics, bookmarked news resources, theme preferences, and onboarding states.

classes.name: OfflineFirstUserDataRepository
classes.description: Implementation of UserDataRepository that manages user data using local preferences data source and logs user actions via analytics.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Sets multiple topic IDs as followed in preferences.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Sets whether a particular topic ID is followed and logs the action.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Bookmarks or unbookmarks a news resource and logs the action.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed.

methods.name: setThemeBrand
methods.description: Sets the theme brand preference and logs the change.

methods.name: setDarkThemeConfig
methods.description: Sets the dark theme configuration and logs the change.

methods.name: setDynamicColorPreference
methods.description: Enables or disables dynamic color preference and logs the change.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Sets whether onboarding should be hidden and logs the change.
